name: Movie Hub HQ Drive
release_notes: Fixed critical staging directory exclusion bug in One-Click Updater that prevented new PHP files from overwriting live files during remote updates
Added automated staging deployment migration (2026_09_28_004_force_deploy_staging_files.php) so older installations immediately apply all updated files on remote update
Removed One-Click Application Update System card from settings.php (exclusively in update.php)
Enabled full Backup & Restore Center at the top of settings.php with automatic backup format detection (Full, Settings Only, Pages Only, Others Only)
